sources.title: Urdatorn/sphragis-alm-olmo3-greek-7b-aeschylus · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Each model is a full further-pretraining of Urdatorn/olmo3-7b-ancient-greek on one author's Sphragis training sentences only; a sentence is attributed to whichever of the seventeen models finds it least surprising. This model was trained on Aeschylus: 2,600 sentences, 190,306 scored tokens from the sentence_1 training split.

sources.snippet: Machine learning for Ancient Greek. Particular research topics include prosody, metre and author attribution.

sources.title: OLMo : Accelerating the Science of Language Models
sources.snippet: We believe that full access to open language models for the research community is critical to the scientific study of these models, their strengths and weaknesses, and their biases and risks.
